issues.detail: Waste / Refuse storage appears under Householder, but the source explicitly EXCLUDES householder applications ('required for major applications (excluding householder applications which are majors by virtue of the site area)'). Streetscene Drawings appear under Listed building consent and Demolition in conservation area, but the source applies them to infill in an existing street, or major development creating new streets. Advertisement drawings / illumination sit under Full planning with the excerpt 'hours of illumination;', which is Lighting Assessment text. More generally, about 30 rows carry 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The source is organised by development type (householder sub-types, non-householder buildings, change of use, dwellings, energy, plant, shop fronts, adverts, LBC, LDC, prior notifications), and each item has its own E/C status.
issues.evidence: Waste Management Statement row; section 2a/2d structure of the July 2025 list

issues.detail: Grokbot shows only Ecological survey and (wrongly) Waste under Householder. The source's householder criteria-based items are: Arboricultural Assessment (trees on or near the boundary); Design and Access Statement (conservation area, new floorspace over 100 sq m); Finished Floor Levels and Flood Risk template (Flood Zones 2, 3a, 3b or Ordinary Watercourse); Preliminary Roost Assessment and Bat Emergence Survey; Sustainable Drainage Assessment (new footprint over 200 sq m, or driveway over 5 sq m); Heritage Statement; Roof plans for complex roofs; cross-section details for windows and doors; material/colour finish and footway/alleyway widths for External Wall Insulation.

Grokbot omitted these local requirements: Accurate Visual Representations (major development in the Central Development Area, conservation areas or affecting heritage/townscape); M4(2) Compliance Statement (essential for dwellings) and M4(3) (care homes); Floorspace Schedule on the council template (any residential); Masterplan (major / 10+ dwellings); Building for a Healthy Life assessment (10+ dwellings); Sustainability Design and Construction Statement (major); Noise Impact Assessment (noisy uses) and Noise Levels Assessment (noise-sensitive uses); Odour Attenuation Scheme; Technical Specification (plant, noisy uses, vent flues); Playing Field Statement; Marketing Information (use not in line with the development plan); Statement of Student Need and draft Student Management Plan (student accommodation); Visual Impact Assessment; Material specifications and samples; joinery section drawings; Roller shutter details (shop fronts); Planning Statement (non-policy-compliant or complex change of use); Finished Floor Levels in flood zones; ICNIRP declaration and Justification Statement (telecoms prior notification); Method Statement for demolition prior notification.

Grokbot marked Outline, Variation of condition s73, Non-material amendment, Lawful development cert and Change of use - prior approval as '(none)'. The source sets: for outline, BNG assessment and metric (essential unless de minimis) and protected species info always expected; for s73, details specified in the condition, plus marked-up drawings and a possible deed of variation; for NMA, marked-up amended drawings; for LDC, a Statement of Interest plus evidence (council tax, utility bills, statutory declarations) and as-existing/as-built plans; for prior notification, demolition site plan and Method Statement, larger home extension site plan, and the telecoms ICNIRP declaration. For LBC, Grokbot leaves out the essential Heritage Statement, Design and Access Statement and photographs, and the conditional Method Statement and roof plans.

Drainage/SuDS: the excerpt says a Sustainable Drainage Assessment is needed for 'more than 5sq.m of hard surfacing'. The source sets 5 sq m for driveways only, and over 200 sq m for new hard surfacing or building footprint. Flood Risk Assessment is cut off at 'is required: 1.' and loses the triggers (FZ2, 3a, 3b or Ordinary Watercourse, or FZ1 sites of 1 ha or more). Planning Obligations shows s73 deed-of-variation text instead of the trigger (10+ units / over 1,000 sq m). Affordable Housing has no threshold (source: 15+ dwellings or 0.5 ha+). Works to trees Photographs quotes trees 'in a conservation area', but photographs and a justification statement are essential only for TPO trees.
issues.evidence: Section 1e/2c SuDS: 'new surfacing exceeds 200 m2 or a driveway exceeds 5 m2'; 4f Works to trees

issues.detail: Most 'Submission rules' tab_items are process text, not requirements: the Planning Portal 30MB file-size limit, redaction of personal information, the 28-day notice for invalid applications, and links to the fire statement form, Sport England advice and the street design guide. The 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' row is encouragement, not a validation requirement. The Design and Access Statement and Fire Statement rows quote the national checklist line ('Submission of a Fire Safety Statement (where required)').
issues.evidence: National Requirements / submitting an application section

issues.detail: Biodiversity Checklist and Ecological Survey are two rows with the identical excerpt ('Biodiversity Survey and Report / Ecological Survey / Protected Species Survey ... PART I'). The Drawing standards tab repeats the scale-bar instruction twice.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows Full planning; tab_items 'A scale bar should be shown...' / 'Scale bars should be included...'

summary: The link is the current July 2025 list, but Grokbot dated it January 2026 from the URL folder. The source's matrix of development types and essential/conditional items is flattened into 'Full planning'. Waste is wrongly placed under Householder, many local items are missing (M4(2), floorspace schedule, AVRs, noise, student, sustainability statement), and the householder and other application types are badly under-captured.
